scenes.title: Fate's Surprise
scenes.summary: As the episode begins, Max philosophizes about life, destiny, and the choices we make, while Chef Viktor Barinov is already busy shouting orders at his suppliers.

scenes.title: Crash on the Street
scenes.summary: Elena accidentally hits someone with her car.

scenes.title: The Alarm Clock
scenes.summary: Max and Sasha are in bed when the alarm goes off.

scenes.title: A Torn Ligament
scenes.summary: Chef Viktor is at the hospital after being hit by a car.

scenes.title: Betting on a Belt
scenes.summary: Fedya and Senya are arguing about cooking meat in the kitchen.

scenes.title: The Leather Belt
scenes.summary: Fedya is doing a strange experiment in the kitchen.

scenes.title: The Stink in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Viktor Petrovich arrives at work in a cast.

scenes.title: Sasha's Apology
scenes.summary: Sasha, a new waitress, accidentally drops something.

scenes.title: The Girl in Green
scenes.summary: Ilya is looking for someone in the restaurant.

scenes.title: Without a Car
scenes.summary: Max and Sasha are relaxing together after work.

scenes.title: Riding Home
scenes.summary: Outside the restaurant after work, Max offers to catch a cab, but Sasha insists on driving him home while reminding him they are only friends.

scenes.title: Money for the Apartment
scenes.summary: Sasha lends Max the money he needs for rent, and Kostya teases Max when he finds out where the cash came from.

scenes.title: An Argument in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: In the kitchen, Fedya mocks Senya as Senya prepares to slice and eat a leather belt after losing their bet.

scenes.title: Important Business
scenes.summary: Viktor tricks Yelena into driving him through Moscow traffic for two hours just to buy watermelon chewing gum at a street kiosk.

scenes.title: The Forgotten Salad
scenes.summary: When guests complain about waiting for their order while Senya is away, Victoria and Max accidentally send Senya's belt salad to the dining room.

scenes.title: Where is My Salad?
scenes.summary: The cook asks his colleague about a missing dish he just prepared.

scenes.title: A Dissatisfied Guest
scenes.summary: A demanding guest complains about his food and demands to see the chef.

scenes.title: A Belt in the Salad
scenes.summary: A furious customer calls the waitress over after finding a belt in his turkey salad.

scenes.title: Quick Reaction
scenes.summary: Max thanks Sasha for saving him and then plays along with Vika's sarcastic joke.

scenes.title: Plans for the Evening
scenes.summary: Max and Kostya talk over their plans for the evening after a hectic shift.

scenes.title: The Eaten Belt
scenes.summary: Max's risky stunt in the kitchen goes awry, forcing the cooks to improvise.

scenes.title: The Price of a Bet
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov and his staff settle the price of their high-stakes kitchen bet.

scenes.title: Justice
scenes.summary: At the end of the shift, the team reflects on fairness and makes amends.
